sources: https://www.cityofatwoodks.com/visitors/lake_campground.php (City of Atwood), read 2026-11-05 (page carries a November 2026 Veterans Day notice): 'Camping/RV Hook-ups at Lake Atwood. Located on the south side of Lake Atwood. Electric hook-ups and bathrooms with showers available. Permits and keys to the hook-ups can be picked up at Atwood Liquor Store - 785-626-9656 , located on the at 402 Grant on Highway 36. Permits are $25/night; weekly and monthly special rates are available.' Nothing on the page about free dry camping on the north side.

RV Life reviews API https://campgrounds.rvlife.com/api/reviews/park/8590 (Atwood Lion's Park, 16 reviews), read 2026-11-05: 10/2024 $30 back-in 'going a block to a liquor store to pay'; 10/2024 $30 'sites are spacious and close to lake'; 7/2024 $30 'operated by the local lions club at the Atwood City lake'; 5/2022 $30 'level sites and FHU'. Google Maps 'Atwood Lion's RV Park' 4.6 stars, 208 reviews, phone +1 785-626-9656.

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-05 (600 m half at 39.8150,-101.0420; 110 m half at the pin 39.81403,-101.04311, with an upscaled crop): Lake Atwood is ~30 acres by a dark-water pixel count. The RV area is a gravel lot ~25 m north of the pin with ~6 rigs plus 2 more under trees just NE; the lake's south-east arm lies ~25-50 m east and south of the pads across open mown grass and a paved walking path on the riprap shore, with scattered trees; the main south shore is ~60-70 m north behind a path and trees.

values.note: Permit $25 a night for a hook-up site (weekly and monthly rates available), from the Atwood Liquor Store, 402 Grant on US-36, which also hands out the hook-up keys.

fees.source: https://www.cityofatwoodks.com/visitors/lake_campground.php, read 2026-11-05: 'Permits are $25/night; weekly and monthly special rates are available.' The derived $0 low (free north-side dry camping from note prose) is not on the city page, so it is replaced.

note: City of Atwood lake park on the south side of Lake Atwood, run with the Lions Club: hook-up sites on a gravel lot by the lake's south-east arm, with showers. Pick up the permit and the hook-up key at the Atwood Liquor Store, 402 Grant on US-36. --Claude
summary: City page (2026): $25/night permit (weekly/monthly rates), electric hook-ups, showers, keys at Atwood Liquor Store 785-626-9656. Fees 0 -> 25/25 (free north-side dry camping is not on the city page); 50 A (derived) left - the city doesn't give amps. Lakefront kept: pads 25-50 m from the lake's SE arm across open grass and a walking path; lake ~30 acres. Phone missing.
